run_ase_viewer: run the ASE data inspector to visualize scene point clouds, trajectory, and 3D bounding boxes in Rerun
run_ase_viewer_with_frame: run the ASE viewer with a specific frame_id to display an undistorted RGB image stitched to the camera view
run_ase_viewer_save_rrd: run the ASE viewer and save the Rerun recording to a .rrd file at the specified output path
review_language_to_bboxes: review how language_to_bboxes converts ASE scene command language entities into 3D bounding boxes with centers, scales, and rotations
review_rerun_logging: review how the main function logs 3D boxes, line strips, points, and camera poses to the Rerun visualization framework
